tools.name: describe_rescue_offer
tools.description: Returns the exact scope, price, service window, acceptance rules, private fit-review URL, and direct x402 purchase URL for the Agent Rescue Desk service.

tools.name: triage_production_failure
tools.description: Classifies one sanitized n8n, MCP, webhook, agent-tool-routing, retry, or general production incident and returns concrete next checks without echoing the submitted incident.

tools.name: get_case_intake_requirements
tools.description: Returns the minimum redacted evidence needed for a fixed-scope fit review and the public intake URL. It does not submit a case.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_case_intake_requirements · Private data: describe_rescue_offer · Public sink: triage_production_failure, get_case_intake_requirements.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_case_intake_requirements · Private data: describe_rescue_offer · Public sink: triage_production_failure, get_case_intake_requirements

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
